purpose: Teach: 未解決/裏切る/見せかけ/煽る/争わ/退け/減らさ/鈍い

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、未解決の社会問題、丁寧に扱いましたね。
lines.en: You handled the unsolved social issues in this paper with real care.
lines.style: Warm, steady approval. Lean forward slightly. Let the observation land—not rushing. Clear eye contact, genuinely impressed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。信頼を裏切る組織の構造、論じました。
lines.en: Yes. I discussed how organizational structures undermine trust.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Slight weight on the core claim. Not defensive, but grounded—speaking from something he's thought through deeply.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 透明性を見せかける広報、批判の対象ですね。
lines.en: The way PR manufactures an appearance of transparency—that's what you pushed back on.
lines.style: Nodding gently, recognizing the move. Thoughtful pace. Voice carries real engagement with the argument, not just the form.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: メディアが世論を煽る役割、別章にしました。
lines.en: I gave media's role in inflaming public opinion its own chapter.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Not explaining, reporting. Slight emphasis on the structural choice—separating this out was deliberate.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 対立陣営と争わずに、議論できる場、必要ですね。
lines.en: Creating spaces where people can actually debate without it turning into camps fighting each other—that's essential.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slow, careful. Voice carries something like quiet conviction—this matters beyond the paper.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 過去の主張を退ける論文、引用、丁寧に。
lines.en: I made sure to cite the older research carefully when I was refuting those claims.
lines.style: Earnest, precise. Not defensive about disagreement—respectful of the scholarship even while pushing back. Steady tempo.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 格差を減らさず維持する政策、批判的視点で扱いましたね。
lines.en: Policies that sustain inequality rather than reducing it—I approached those with a critical eye.
lines.style: Controlled intensity. Not angry, but the words carry weight. Clear, deliberate articulation of the stance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感受性が鈍い研究者、見直しが必要ですね。
lines.en: Some researchers have become insensitive to these patterns. Their work needs real scrutiny.
lines.style: Firm close. Light edge underneath—frustration with blindness, not with people. Conviction settling in at the end, not wavering.
